meta.name: multi-agent-meeting
meta.description: 模拟多个AI智能体协作开会并进行决策讨论的场景。适用于需要从多个专业角度分析问题、进行辩论和达成共识的场景，如项目决策、技术方案评审、商业策略制定等。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个AI智能体协作开会并做出决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从多角度分析问题并达成共识
copy.tagline_en: Simulate multi-agent meetings for collaborative decision-making
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze problems from multiple perspectives and reach consensus

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的问题变成一场多智能体会议：自动设计 3-5 个不同专业背景的角色，按开场、辩论、共识等阶段模拟讨论，最后输出包含结论、论据、风险与后续行动的会议记录。
howto.when: 当你需要从多个角度分析问题、让不同领域知识碰撞，或模拟团队决策讨论时触发。

say.text: 请召开会议，讨论我们是否该采用微服务架构，输出结论和风险。
say.note: Claude 会配置技术相关角色并模拟完整会议。

say.text: 组织一个产品定价决策会，角色包括产品经理、财务顾问和销售总监。
say.note: 按你指定的角色开会并生成定价建议。

say.text: 模拟一次项目风险评估会议，列出风险清单和应对措施。
say.note: Claude 会从多角色视角输出风险评估记录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude turns your question into a multi-agent meeting: it designs 3-5 roles with different expertise, simulates discussion stages from opening to debate and consensus, then outputs a full meeting record with conclusions, arguments, risks, and next actions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need multi-angle analysis, cross-domain knowledge clash, or a simulated team decision discussion.

say_en.text: Hold a meeting to discuss whether we should adopt microservices, and output conclusions and risks.
say_en.note: Claude configures tech roles and runs a full simulation.

say_en.text: Organize a pricing decision meeting with a product manager, financial advisor, and sales director.
say_en.note: It uses your given roles and generates pricing recommendations.

say_en.text: Simulate a project risk assessment meeting and list risks plus countermeasures.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a multi-perspective risk record.
